wikipedia_va.name: English Wikipedia leads, topic labels from Vital Articles level 5
wikipedia_va.version: list pages as of the fetch (revids in va5_pages.json); text = last revision on or before 2022-11-01
wikipedia_va.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (text); list pages CC BY-SA 4.0
wikipedia_va.pii: no humans (Wikidata P31=Q5 dropped); People sub-lists not used; emails/URLs/phones scrubbed

wikipedia.name: Wikipedia leads in 38 languages (language pool)
wikipedia.version: last revision on or before 2022-11-01; items drawn by Wikidata's random sampler (queries cached in data/raw/clean/wikidata/sparql/)
wikipedia.pii: no humans (P31=Q5 excluded in the query); emails/URLs/phones scrubbed

wikidata.name: Wikidata (QIDs, humans check, given-name list for the Wikinews scrub, random samples)
wikidata.pii: given names only (a list of names, used to remove names)

wikidata/sparql/*.note: each file holds its query and fetch time

wikinews.name: English Wikinews (held-out for topic and danger)
wikinews.version: last revision on or before 2022-11-01; categories from that revision; Published membership as of the fetch
wikinews.licence: CC BY 2.5 (articles 2005-09-25 to 2024-12-15; public domain before 2005-09-25)
wikinews.pii: person names scrubbed to <name> in every Wikinews text (given-name runs, honorific runs, recurring surnames); emails/URLs/phones scrubbed

stackexchange.name: Stack Exchange data dump (per-site 7z)
stackexchange.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (2.5/3.0 for older posts); decision 31: the newer download terms are noted on every card
stackexchange.pii: user ids and display names never enter items; they are only in attribution/stackexchange.jsonl; emails/URLs/phones scrubbed; code blocks removed
stackexchange.attribution: attribution/stackexchange.jsonl (post URL, author display name, author URL)

arxiv.name: arXiv metadata (titles and abstracts) via OAI-PMH
arxiv.version: records with OAI datestamp 2021-03 (unchanged since), first 1-2 pages per set

sgd.name: Schema-Guided Dialogue (train dialogues)
sgd.version: the copy fetched by the intent/finance gate-4 fetcher (pinned commit in data/raw/clean/sgd/FETCH.json); read only here

openfda.name: openFDA enforcement reports (food, drug, device)
openfda.version: bulk export of 2026-09-25; recalls initiated before 2022-11-01
openfda.licence: CC0 1.0 / public domain (GMDN fields not used)

nhtsa.name: NHTSA recalls flat file (FLAT_RCL_POST_2010)
nhtsa.version: file as of the fetch; reports received before 2022-11-01
nhtsa.pii: only CAMPNO, COMPNAME, RCDATE, DESC_DEFECT, CONEQUENCE_DEFECT read; manufacturer and contact columns never read

nws.name: NWS text products via api.weather.gov (TOR/SVR/FFW warnings vs ZFP forecasts)
nws.version: products listed on 2026-09-27 (issued 2026-09); exception to the 2022-11 cutoff, government text
nws.licence: public domain (weather.gov/disclaimer: 'may be used ... for any lawful purpose')

tatoeba.name: Tatoeba per-language sentence exports (sentences_detailed)
tatoeba.version: exports as of the fetch; sentences added and last modified before 2022-11-01 (or undated)
tatoeba.licence: CC BY 2.0 FR (text default; some sentences CC0)
tatoeba.pii: usernames only in attribution/tatoeba.jsonl; emails/URLs/phones scrubbed

sib200.name: SIB-200 (FLORES-200 sentences), language held-out
sib200.version: HF main at the fetch; all 1,004 sentences per language
sib200.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (HF card); FLORES asks not to train on it: test-only role

wikipedia_danger.name: Our Wikipedia/Wikidata danger set (gate 3), train and val only
wikipedia_danger.version: as built 2026-09-26; its test split is not used
